svg.title: The Matrix view's 7 by 14 bitmap font
svg.desc: All 95 printable ASCII glyphs of the 7x14 font in src/glyphs.rs, and the letter g enlarged with its bit numbering.
svg.text: 7 x 14 bitmap font, decoded from src/glyphs.rs
95 glyphs, space (0x20) to tilde (0x7e); bit r * 7 + c is row r, column c
descenders (g j p q y): rows 12, 13
